ideas.title: Investigating Trump's 'War on Fraud'
ideas.description: This story would investigate the Trump administration's 'war on fraud' and its potential impact on vulnerable populations. It would examine the appointment of VP Vance to lead the effort and the motivations behind the administration's priorities.
questions: What are the specific goals and objectives of Trump's 'war on fraud'?
How will the administration's efforts impact vulnerable populations?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover important information about the Trump administration's priorities and motivations. By following the money and examining the administration's actions, we may be able to shed light on potential corruption or abuse of power.
